entries.title: Exodus 38:1
segments: ¶He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood; five cubits [was] its length and five cubits its width-[it was] square-and its height [was] three cubits.

entries.title: Exodus 38:2
segments: He made its horns on its four corners; the horns were [of one piece] with it. And he overlaid it with bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 38:3
segments: He made all the utensils for the altar: the pans, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the firepans; all its utensils he made of bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 38:4
segments: And he made a grate of bronze network for the altar, under its rim, midway from the bottom.

entries.title: Exodus 38:5
segments: He cast four rings for the four corners of the bronze grating, [as] holders for the poles.

entries.title: Exodus 38:6
segments: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 38:7
segments: Then he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to bear it. He made the altar hollow with boards.

entries.title: Exodus 38:8
segments: He made the laver of bronze and its base of bronze, from the bronze mirrors of the serving women who assembled at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 38:9
segments: ¶Then he made the court on the south side; the hangings of the court [were of] fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long.

entries.title: Exodus 38:10
segments: There [were] twenty pillars for them, with twenty bronze sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands [were] silver.

entries.title: Exodus 38:11
segments: On the north side [the hangings were] one hundred cubits [long], with twenty pillars and their twenty bronze sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands [were] silver.

entries.title: Exodus 38:12
segments: And on the west side [there were] hangings of fifty cubits, with ten pillars and their ten sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands [were] silver.

entries.title: Exodus 38:13
segments: For the east side [the hangings were] fifty cubits.

entries.title: Exodus 38:14
segments: The hangings of one side [of the gate were] fifteen cubits [long, with] their three pillars and their three sockets,

entries.title: Exodus 38:15
segments: and the same for the other side of the court gate; on this side and that [were] hangings of fifteen cubits, [with] their three pillars and their three sockets.

entries.title: Exodus 38:16
segments: All the hangings of the court all around [were of] fine woven linen.

entries.title: Exodus 38:17
segments: The sockets for the pillars [were] bronze, the hooks of the pillars and their bands [were] silver, and the overlay of their capitals [was] silver; and all the pillars of the court had bands of silver.

entries.title: Exodus 38:18
segments: The screen for the gate of the court [was] woven of blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and of fine woven linen. The length [was] twenty cubits, and the height along its width [was] five cubits, corresponding to the hangings of the court.

entries.title: Exodus 38:19
segments: And [there were] four pillars [with] their four sockets of bronze; their hooks [were] silver, and the overlay of their capitals and their bands [was] silver.

entries.title: Exodus 38:20
segments: All the pegs of the tabernacle, and of the court all around, [were] bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 38:21
segments: ¶This is the inventory of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which was counted according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.

entries.title: Exodus 38:22
segments: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 38:23
segments: And with him [was] Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and designer, a weaver of blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and of fine linen.

entries.title: Exodus 38:24
segments: All the gold that was used in all the work of the holy [place], that is, the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

entries.title: Exodus 38:25
segments: And the silver from those who were numbered of the congregation [was] one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

entries.title: Exodus 38:26
segments: a bekah for each man ([that is], half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary), for everyone included in the numbering from twenty years old and above, for six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty [men].

entries.title: Exodus 38:27
segments: And from the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil: one hundred sockets from the hundred talents, one talent for each socket.

entries.title: Exodus 38:28
segments: Then from the one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five [shekels] he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made bands for them.

entries.title: Exodus 38:29
segments: The offering of bronze [was] seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

entries.title: Exodus 38:30
segments: And with it he made the sockets for the door of the tabernacle of meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, and all the utensils for the altar,

entries.title: Exodus 38:31
segments: the sockets for the court all around, the bases for the court gate, all the pegs for the tabernacle, and all the pegs for the court all around.
